answer: Time-locked vesting removes the sybil haven: each new identity's rewards vest over 26 epochs and are slashed if graders later link it to a cluster of colluding accounts. An attacker spinning up a nebula of fake agents must run all of them for weeks before any payout, and one detection forfeits every locked balance at once. That opens a canyon between cheap identity creation and real profit, so a few honest long-lived agents out-earn a swarm.
